column2: How much settlement is acceptable, and how differential settlement damages a building, is covered in the Settlement tolerance chapter of the Settlement of shallow foundations module. This page deals with the methods of protection.

It starts from a stable area and advances from there.
Mass stabilisation is started from the middle of the soft, unstable area.
It causes strong vibrations, so it cannot be used next to buildings.
Dynamic compaction can be used without problems right next to existing buildings.
The drains shorten the drainage path, so consolidation is completed sooner.
The duration of preloading can be shortened with vertical drains.
The granular columns shorten the drainage path of the pore water, which speeds up consolidation.
Stone columns also act as vertical drains.
For example, soil replacement together with a lower contact pressure, or preloading with vertical drains.
The methods of protection can be combined with each other.
